newsitem.title: USA: APL Ltd Q3 profit rises includes gain.
newsitem.headline: APL Ltd Q3 profit rises includes gain.

text.p: NOTE - 1996 Q3 and 9 month period includes gain of $12.9 million resulting from the curtailment of obligations for pension and postretirement benefits due to workforce reductions.
1996 nine month period includes gain of $6.9 million on the sale of its domestic brokerage business and a first quarter gain of $1.6 million on a vessel sale.

1995 Q3 and nine month period includes gains of $3.6 million from the sale of a vessel and vessel construction contracts and $3.5 million in liquidated damages from the delayed delivery of two C11-class vessels.
1995 periods includes charges related to its corporate initiatives of $5.7 million and $18.3 million in the third quarter and first three quarters of 1995, respectively.
1995 period reflects conversion of preferred stock into 4 million shares.
